notes: Security fix: removed the hardcoded OpenAI API key used for /import and /restore summary generation (the old key was exposed and had to be revoked). Summaries are now generated by calling the AthenaUI backend you already run, using whichever chat provider/API key you have already configured there -- no separate key to set up here, nothing breaks if AthenaUI is not running (summaries are just skipped, same as before).
